## A. Phylogenetic tree

(A) phylogenetic relationships among 30 R. solanacearum strains based on egl gene sequences.

```{r tree}
library(ape)
library(ggtree)
library(ggplot2)
rs_rgl <- read.tree("egl.nwk")
rs_rgl$edge.length[rs_rgl$edge.length < 0] <- 0
replacements <- c(
  "GMI1000" = "*GMI1000",
  "PSS81" = "*PSS81", 
  "Tb43" = "*Tb43",
  "MAD17" = "*MAD17",
  "CMR121" = "*CMR121",
  "UW551" = "*UW551",
  "CMR66" = "*CMR66",
  "CFBP3059" = "*CFBP3059",
  "Psi7" = "*Psi7",
  "ACH732" = "*ACH732"
)

for(old_name in names(replacements)) {
  rs_rgl$tip.label[rs_rgl$tip.label == old_name] <- replacements[old_name]
}

fig2a <- ggtree(rs_rgl, layout="equal_angle",size=0.3, branch.length = 'none')+
  geom_tiplab(aes(color = grepl("^\\*", label)), size = 2, offset = 0.3) +  
  scale_color_manual(values = c("black", "red")) +  
  theme(legend.position = "none")
ggsave(paste0(output_dir, "fig2A.pdf", sep=""), fig2a, width = 5, height = 5)
fig2a
```



## B. pca

(B) Principal component analysis (PCA) of response and resource-utilization traits of R. solanacearum. 

```{r pca}
library(FactoMineR)
library(magrittr)
library(dplyr)
library(factoextra)
library(ggplot2)
library(vegan)

phy_metafile <- read.delim("../data/phy_metafile.txt")
trait_data <- read.delim("../data/trait_data.txt")
res.pca <- PCA(trait_data[,1:51], 
               scale.unit = F,ncp = 11, quanti.sup = NULL, quali.sup = NULL, 
               row.w = NULL, col.w = NULL, graph = FALSE)

sam=data.frame(res.pca$ind$coord) %>% .[1:2] %>% data.frame(.,phy_metafile)
cent = aggregate(sam[, 1:2], by = list(sam$cluster),FUN = mean)
colnames(cent) = c("Cluster", "cent1", "cent2")
PCAframe = left_join(data.frame(sam, joint = sam$cluster), 
                     data.frame(cent[, 2:3], joint = cent$Cluster)) %>% suppressMessages()
PCAframe = PCAframe[, -which(colnames(PCAframe) == "joint")]

adonis2(trait_data[,1:51]~phy_metafile$cluster,method="euclidean")

fig2b <- ggplot(PCAframe)+
  geom_hline(yintercept=0,linetype=2,color="#666666") +
  geom_vline(xintercept=0,linetype=2,color="#666666") +
  geom_segment(aes(x=Dim.1,y=Dim.2,xend = cent1, yend = cent2,color=cluster),show.legend = FALSE, size = 0.3, alpha = 0.6)+
  geom_point(data = cent,aes(x=cent1,y=cent2,color=factor(Cluster)),size=2,alpha=.8)+
  geom_point(size=1,alpha=.5,aes(x=Dim.1,y=Dim.2,color=factor(cluster)))+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#ef1828","#ffbc14",
                                "#00bdcd","#006b7b"))+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#ef1828","#ffbc14",
                               "#00bdcd","#006b7b"))+
  annotate("text",x = 1, y = 1,label = "atop(R^2 == 0.35, italic(p) < 0.001)",
           parse = TRUE,size = 2.5)+
  labs(x=paste0("PC1 (",get_eigenvalue(res.pca) %>% .[1,2]%>% round(.,2),"%)"),
       y=paste0("PC2 (",get_eigenvalue(res.pca) %>% .[2,2]%>% round(.,2),"%)"),
       fill="Cluster",color="Cluster")+
  theme_minimal()+
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 7,face = "bold"),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 6,color="black"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 6,color="black"),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 7,face = "bold"),
        legend.key.size = unit(0.4, 'cm'),
        legend.position = "bottom")

ggsave(paste0(output_dir, "fig2B.pdf", sep=""), fig2b, width = 5, height = 5)
fig2b
```



## C. pcoa

(C) Principal coordinates analysis (PCoA) of bacterial communities following inoculation with different strains.

```{r pcoa}
library(ggplot2)
library(LorMe)
library(vegan)
groupfile <- read.delim("../data/groupfile.txt")
asv_table <- read.delim("../data/asv_table.txt")
asv_taxonomy <- read.delim("../data/asv_taxonomy.txt")

asv_object <- tax_summary(groupfile = groupfile,
                          inputtable = asv_table[,-1],reads = T,
                          taxonomytable = asv_taxonomy,
                          outputtax = "standard")
asv_object2 <- object_config(taxobj =asv_object,
                             treat_location = 8,
                             rep_location = 5,
                             treat_col = c("gray","#ef1828","#ffbc14",
                                           "#00bdcd","#006b7b"))

all_structure=structure_plot(taxobj =asv_object2,taxlevel = "Genus")
pcoa_coord=all_structure$PCoA_coordinates

set.seed(999)
adonis2(t(asv_object2$Genus[,-c(1,7:14)])~cluster,data=asv_object2$groupfile[-7:-14,])

fig2c <- ggplot(pcoa_coord)+
  geom_hline(yintercept=0,linetype=2,color="#666666") +
  geom_vline(xintercept=0,linetype=2,color="#666666")+
  geom_point(aes(x=`PCOA1(58.4%)`,y=`PCOA2(6.6%)`,color=cluster,shape=cluster),fill="gray",size=1)+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("black","#ef1828","#ffbc14","#00bdcd","#006b7b"))+
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(24,20,20,20,20,20))+
  labs(x="PCoA 1 (58.4%)",y="PCoA 2 (6.6%)")+
  annotate("text",x = 0.2, y = -0.18,label = "R^2 == 0.32 * ',' ~~ italic(p) < 0.001",parse = TRUE,size = 3) +
  theme_minimal()+
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 7,face = "bold"),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 6,color="black"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 6,color="black"),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 6,face = "bold"),
        legend.key.size = unit(0.4, 'cm'),
  )
ggsave(paste0(output_dir, "fig2C.pdf", sep=""), fig2c, width = 5, height = 4)
```

## D. VPA

(D) Variation partitioning analysis (VPA) showing the proportion of community variation explained by response and resource-utilization traits.

```{r VPA}
library(ggplot2)
library(LorMe)
library(magrittr)
library(dplyr)
library(vegan)
library(ggforce)

groupfile <- read.delim("../data/groupfile.txt")
asv_table <- read.delim("../data/asv_table.txt")
asv_taxonomy <- read.delim("../data/asv_taxonomy.txt")
trait_data <- read.delim("../data/trait_data.txt")

asv_object <- tax_summary(groupfile = groupfile,
                          inputtable = asv_table[,-1],reads = T,
                          taxonomytable = asv_taxonomy,
                          outputtax = "standard")
asv_object2 <- object_config(taxobj =asv_object,
                             treat_location = 8,
                             rep_location = 5,
                             treat_col = c("gray","#ef1828","#ffbc14",
                                           "#00bdcd","#006b7b"))

rda_asv <- data.frame(asv_object2$Genus[,-1],row.names = asv_object2$Genus_taxonomy$GenusID) %>% 
  .[,-c(7:14)] #remove CK
rda_env=data.frame(ID=colnames(rda_asv),sampleID=asv_object2$groupfile$strain[-c(7:14)]) %>% 
  left_join(.,trait_data)
rownames(rda_env)=rda_env$ID
rda_env=rda_env[,-c(1:2,54)]
env_anno=data.frame(name=colnames(rda_env[,1:51]),ID=paste0("Env",1:51))
colnames(rda_env)=paste0("Env",1:51)

#RDA
rda_result_resource=tbRDA_analysis(otudata = rda_asv,envdata = rda_env[,11:51],collinearity = T,perm.test = F)
rda_env1<-as.data.frame(rda_result_resource$rdascores$biplot)
rda_env1$ID=rownames(rda_env1)
rda_env1=left_join(rda_env1,env_anno)

rda_result_env=tbRDA_analysis(otudata = rda_asv,envdata = rda_env[,1:10],collinearity = T,perm.test = F)
rda_env2<-as.data.frame(rda_result_env$rdascores$biplot)
rda_env2$ID=rownames(rda_env2)
rda_env2=left_join(rda_env2,env_anno)

models <- list(Response = rda_result_env$rda_object,
               Resource = rda_result_resource$rda_object)

rda_table <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(models), function(x) {
  m <- models[[x]]
  a <- anova.cca(m, permutations = 9999)
  r <- RsquareAdj(m)

  data.frame(
    Model = x,
    Variables = m$CCA$qrank,
    Model_Df = a$Df[1],
    Residual_Df = a$Df[2],
    R2 = round(r$r.squared, 3),
    Adjusted_R2 = round(r$adj.r.squared, 3),
    F = round(a$F[1], 3),
    P = a$`Pr(>F)`[1]
  )
}))

#VPA
rda.vpa <- varpart(t(rda_asv), rda_env[,rda_env2$ID],rda_env[,rda_env1$ID], transfo="hel",chisquare = FALSE) 
v <- rda.vpa$part$indfract$Adj.R.square * 100

circles <- data.frame(x0 = c(0, 1.2),y0 = 0,r  = 1)

labels <- data.frame(
  x = c(-0.35, 1.55, -0.35, 0.60, 1.55, 0.60),
  y = c(0.40, 0.40, -0.25, 0, -0.25, -1.25),
  label = c("Environmental\nresponse","Resource\nutilization",
            sprintf("%.1f%%", v[1]),sprintf("%.1f%%", v[3]),sprintf("%.1f%%", v[2]),
            "Unexplained = 32.1%"))

fig2d <- ggplot() +
  geom_circle(data = circles,aes(x0 = x0, y0 = y0, r = r),
              fill = "grey80",colour = "grey50",alpha = 0.7,linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_text(data = labels,aes(x, y, label = label), size = 4.5) +
  coord_fixed( xlim = c(-1.1, 2.3),ylim = c(-1.45, 1.1)) +
  theme_void()
ggsave(paste0(output_dir, "fig2D.pdf", sep=""), fig2d, width = 5, height = 4)
fig2d
```



## E. Elastic net

(E) Key strain traits associated with community disturbance (Bray-Curtis distance to CK) selected via elastic net regression.

```{r key_traits}
library(glmnet)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(LorMe)
library(vegan)
library(tidyr)
library(magrittr)

groupfile <- read.delim("../data/groupfile.txt")
asv_table <- read.delim("../data/asv_table.txt")
asv_taxonomy <- read.delim("../data/asv_taxonomy.txt")
phy_metafile <- read.delim("../data/phy_metafile.txt")
trait_data <- read.delim("../data/trait_data.txt")

asv_object <- tax_summary(groupfile = groupfile,
                          inputtable = asv_table[,-1],reads = T,
                          taxonomytable = asv_taxonomy,
                          outputtax = "standard")
asv_object2 <- object_config(taxobj =asv_object,
                             treat_location = 8,
                             rep_location = 5,
                             treat_col = c("gray","#ef1828","#ffbc14",
                                           "#00bdcd","#006b7b"))

adonis_stat=data.frame()
dis_frame=data.frame()
for(i in unique(phy_metafile$sampleID)){
  sub_data=sub_tax_summary(taxobj = asv_object2,strain==i|site=="Water")
  adonis_result=adonis2(t(sub_data$Genus[,-1])~site,data=sub_data$groupfile)
  r2=adonis_result$R2[1]
  p=adonis_result$`Pr(>F)`[1]
  cluster=phy_metafile$cluster[phy_metafile$sampleID==i]
  adonis_stat=rbind(adonis_stat,data.frame(strain=i,r2,p,cluster))
  #
  ck=grep("CK",sub_data$groupfile$sample_ID)
  nock=1:11 %>% .[-grep("CK",sub_data$groupfile$sample_ID)]
  sub_dis_frame=sub_data$Genus %>% .[,-1] %>%
    t() %>% vegdist() %>% as.matrix() %>% as.data.frame()
  sub_dis_frame=sub_dis_frame[ck,nock]%>% gather(.,"Pair","value")
  
  sub_dis_frame$strain=i
  sub_dis_frame$cluster=cluster
  dis_frame=rbind(dis_frame,sub_dis_frame)
}

disturbance <- dis_frame %>% group_by(strain, cluster) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_value = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Cross-validation for selecting the best lambda
alphas <- seq(0.1, 0.9, by = 0.1)
results <- data.frame()

set.seed(222)
for(alpha in alphas){
  cv_fit <- cv.glmnet(as.matrix(trait_data[,1:51]), 
                      disturbance$mean_value,
                      alpha=alpha, nfolds=5,
                      standardize = F,  # 自动标准化
                      family = "gaussian")
  # lambda.min
  idx_min <- which.min(cv_fit$cvm)
  # lambda.1se
  idx_1se <- which(cv_fit$lambda == cv_fit$lambda.1se)
  results <- rbind(results, data.frame(
    alpha = alpha,
    # lambda.1se
    lambda_1se = cv_fit$lambda.1se,
    mse_1se = cv_fit$cvm[idx_1se],
    cvsd_1se = cv_fit$cvsd[idx_1se],
    nzero_1se = cv_fit$nzero[idx_1se],
    # lambda.min
    lambda_min = cv_fit$lambda.min,
    mse_min = cv_fit$cvm[idx_min],
    cvsd_min = cv_fit$cvsd[idx_min],
    nzero_min = cv_fit$nzero[idx_min]
  ))
}

# write.table(results,"./best_alpha_lambda.txt",quote = F,sep = "\t",col.names = T,row.names = F)
best <- results %>% slice_min(mse_min, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)

final_fit <- glmnet(as.matrix(trait_data[,1:51]),
                 disturbance$mean_value,
                 alpha = best$alpha,  
                 lambda = best$lambda_min,
                 standardize = F, 
                 family = "gaussian")

coefficient_df <- as.matrix(coef(final_fit)) %>% as.data.frame() %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("variable") %>%
  rename(coefficient = s0) %>%
  filter(variable != "(Intercept)",coefficient != 0) %>%
  mutate(
    Direction = if_else(coefficient > 0, "Positive", "Negative"),
    group = if_else(variable %in% c("maxiumbiomass", "Twiching"),
      "Environmental response","Resource utilization")) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(coefficient)))

fig2e <- ggplot(coefficient_df,
  aes(x = reorder(variable, -abs(coefficient)),
      y = coefficient,fill = group)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Resource utilization" = "lightgray",
               "Environmental response" = "#686868")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Coefficient value") +
  theme_classic2() +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size = 6),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 7, face = "bold"),
    axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.3),
    axis.line.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.3),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 6)
  )

ggsave(paste0(output_dir, "fig2E.pdf", sep=""), fig2e, width = 5, height = 4)
fig2e
```



## F. Community assembly

(F) Relative contributions of deterministic processes (homogeneous and variable selection) and stochastic processes to rhizosphere bacterial community assembly following inoculation with different strains/clusters.

```{r assembly}
library(ggplot2)
library(magrittr)

phy_metafile <- read.delim("../data/phy_metafile.txt")
betanti <- read.delim("betanti.txt")

allnti_plot <- table(betanti[,c(14,16)]) %>% as.data.frame() %>% 
  aggregate(Freq ~ strain + group, data = .,FUN = function(x) (x / sum(.$Freq[.$strain == .$strain[which(.$Freq == x)[1]]])) * 100)
allnti_plot$cluster <- rep(phy_metafile$cluster,3)

fig2f <- ggplot(allnti_plot,aes(x=strain,y=Freq,fill=group))+
  geom_col(width = 0.8)+
  facet_grid(~cluster,scales = "free",space = "free")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#156077","#f46f20","#ffdf00"))+
  labs(x="Ralstonia solanacearum strains",y="Ecological processes(%)",fill="")+
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0))+
  theme_minimal()+
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 7,face = "bold"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6,color="black"),
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.line.y = element_line(),
        axis.ticks.y = element_line(),
        plot.title = element_text(size=7,face="bold"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 6,color="black"),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 6,face = "bold"),
        legend.key.size = unit(0.3, 'cm'),
        legend.position = "bottom")
ggsave(paste0(output_dir, "fig2F.pdf", sep=""), fig2f, width = 5, height = 3)
fig2f
```



## G. Correlation

(G) Pearson correlation between the relative contribution of deterministic processes (RRdeterministic) and pairwise strain traits distance.

```{r correlation}
library(ggplot2)
library(magrittr)
library(LorMe)
library(phyloseq)
library(vegan)
library(dplyr)

groupfile <- read.delim("../data/groupfile.txt")
asv_table <- read.delim("../data/asv_table.txt")
asv_taxonomy <- read.delim("../data/asv_taxonomy.txt")
trait_data <- read.delim("../data/trait_data.txt")

asv_object <- tax_summary(groupfile = groupfile,
                          inputtable = asv_table[,-1],reads = T,
                          taxonomytable = asv_taxonomy,
                          outputtax = "standard")
asv_object2 <- object_config(taxobj =asv_object,
                             treat_location = 8,
                             rep_location = 5,
                             treat_col = c("gray","#ef1828","#ffbc14",
                                           "#00bdcd","#006b7b"))
#strain Euclidean
strain_matrix <- vegdist(trait_data[, 1:51],method = "euclidean") %>%as.matrix()
dimnames(strain_matrix) <- list(trait_data$sampleID,trait_data$sampleID)

#micro Bray-Curtis
micro_matrix0 <- t(asv_object2$Genus[, -1]) %>%
  vegdist(method = "bray") %>%
  as.matrix() %>% .[-(7:14), -(7:14), drop = FALSE] 

micro_names <- gsub("\\.", "-",substr(rownames(micro_matrix0), 1, 6))
index <- which(upper.tri(micro_matrix0), arr.ind = TRUE)
micro_pair <- data.frame(sample1 = micro_names[index[, 1]],
                         sample2 = micro_names[index[, 2]],
                         value   = micro_matrix0[index]) %>%
  filter(sample1 != sample2) %>%
  mutate(s1 = pmin(sample1, sample2),s2 = pmax(sample1, sample2)) %>%
  group_by(s1, s2) %>%
  summarise(value = mean(value), .groups = "drop")

samples <- sort(unique(c(micro_pair$s1, micro_pair$s2)))
micro_matrix <- matrix(0,length(samples),length(samples),
                       dimnames = list(samples, samples))

i <- match(micro_pair$s1, samples)
j <- match(micro_pair$s2, samples)

micro_matrix[cbind(i, j)] <- micro_pair$value
micro_matrix[cbind(j, i)] <- micro_pair$value

#Deterministic
betanti <- read.delim("betanti.txt")
allnti_plot <- table(betanti[,c(14,16)]) %>% as.data.frame() %>% 
  aggregate(Freq ~ strain + group, data = .,FUN = function(x) (x / sum(.$Freq[.$strain == .$strain[which(.$Freq == x)[1]]])) * 100)

Deterministic <- data.frame(strain=allnti_plot$strain[1:30],
                            process='Deterministic',
                            Freq=allnti_plot$Freq[1:30]+allnti_plot$Freq[61:90])

#
common <- Reduce(intersect,list(rownames(strain_matrix),rownames(micro_matrix),Deterministic$strain))
strain_matrix <- strain_matrix[common, common]
micro_matrix  <- micro_matrix[common, common]

det_value <- Deterministic$Freq[match(common, Deterministic$strain)]

#RRdeterministic
RR_matrix <- abs(outer(log(det_value),log(det_value),"-"))
dimnames(RR_matrix) <- list(common, common)

#mantel test
set.seed(123)
m1 <- mantel(as.dist(RR_matrix),as.dist(micro_matrix),method = "pearson",permutations = 999)
m2 <- mantel(as.dist(RR_matrix),as.dist(strain_matrix),method = "pearson",permutations = 999)
m3 <- mantel(as.dist(micro_matrix),as.dist(strain_matrix),method = "pearson",permutations = 999)
mantel_results <- data.frame(
  comparison = c("RR vs micro","RR vs strain","micro vs strain"),
  mantel_r = c(m1$statistic,m2$statistic,m3$statistic),
  p_value = c(m1$signif,m2$signif,m3$signif))

#Visualization
ind <- which(upper.tri(strain_matrix, diag = FALSE),arr.ind = TRUE) 
pairwise_distance <- data.frame(
  sample1 = rownames(strain_matrix)[ind[, 1]],
  sample2 = colnames(strain_matrix)[ind[, 2]],
  strain_euclidean = strain_matrix[ind],
  micro_bray = micro_matrix[ind],
  RRdeterministic = RR_matrix[ind]
)
# write.table(strain_matrix,"strain_matrix.txt",quote = F,sep = "\t",row.names = T,col.names = T)
# write.table(micro_matrix,"micro_matrix.txt",quote = F,sep = "\t",row.names = T,col.names = T)
# write.table(RR_matrix,"RR_matrix.txt",quote = F,sep = "\t",row.names = T,col.names = T)
fig2g <- ggplot(pairwise_distance,aes(x=`strain_euclidean`,y=RRdeterministic))+
  geom_point(shape=21,alpha=0.5,fill="#cacaca",color="#a9a9a9",size=0.7)+
  geom_smooth(method = "lm",se = FALSE,color="#515151",linewidth=0.5)+
  labs(x="Strain trait differences",y="RRdeterministic")+
  theme_classic()+
  annotate("text",x = 1.6,y=2,label = paste0(
    "Mantel~italic(r) == ",
    round(mantel_results$mantel_r[2], 2),
    "*','~~italic(p) == ",
    formatC(mantel_results$p_value[2], format = "f", digits = 3)),
    parse = TRUE,size=2)+
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 7,face = "bold"),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 6,color="black"),
        axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.3),
        axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.3),
        plot.title = element_text(size=7,face="bold"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 6,color="black"),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 6,face = "bold"),
        legend.key.size = unit(0.5, 'cm'),
        legend.position = "none")
ggsave(paste0(output_dir, "fig2G.pdf", sep=""), fig2g, width = 2, height = 2)
fig2g
```



## H. Interval correlation

(H) Pearson correlation between RRdeterministic and Bray-Curtis microbial community dissimilarity with increasing trait dissimilarity of the invader strains.

```{r interval}
library(ggplot2)
library(magrittr)

strain_matrix <- read.delim("strain_matrix.txt")
micro_matrix <- read.delim("micro_matrix.txt")
RR_matrix <- read.delim("RR_matrix.txt")

colnames(strain_matrix) <- rownames(strain_matrix)
colnames(micro_matrix) <- rownames(micro_matrix)
colnames(RR_matrix) <- rownames(RR_matrix)

thresholds <- seq(1.7,max(strain_matrix, na.rm = TRUE), by = 0.01)

get_curve <- function(RR_matrix) {
  sapply(thresholds, function(threshold) {
    keep <- upper.tri(strain_matrix) &
      strain_matrix < threshold
    cor(RR_matrix[keep],micro_matrix[keep],
        method = "pearson",
        use = "complete.obs")
  })
}
observed_curve <- get_curve(RR_matrix)
curve_data <- data.frame(threshold = thresholds,correlation = observed_curve)

#Permutation test
observed_slope <- coef(lm(correlation ~ threshold, data = curve_data))[2]
observed_slope

set.seed(123)
nperm <- 999
permuted_slopes <- replicate(
  nperm,
  {
    id <- sample(seq_len(nrow(RR_matrix)))
    RR_random <- RR_matrix[id, id]
    random_curve <- get_curve(RR_random)
    coef(lm(random_curve ~ thresholds))[2]
  }
)

pvalue <- (
  sum(abs(permuted_slopes) >= abs(observed_slope)) + 1
) / (nperm + 1)

fig2h <- ggplot(curve_data,aes(x=threshold,y=observed_curve))+
  geom_point(size=0.5,shape=19,color="#a9a9a9")+
  labs(x="Trait distance thresholds",y="Correlation coefficient\n(RR deterministic - BC dissimilarity)")+
  annotate("text",x=3,y=0.7,
           label="Permutation~italic(p) == 0.021",
           parse = TRUE,size = 2)+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 7,face = "bold"),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 6,color="black"),
        axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.3),
        axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.3),
        plot.title = element_text(size=7,face="bold"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 6,color="black"),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 6,face = "bold"),
        legend.key.size = unit(0.5, 'cm'),
        legend.position = "none")

ggsave(paste0(output_dir, "fig2H.pdf", sep=""), fig2h, width = 2, height = 2)
fig2h
```
